name: Foul Font
disable: DC 17 Nature check (trained) to draw upon the suppressed Primal energies of this place to cleanse the font, DC 23 Religion check (expert) to suppress the void energies, DC 20 Thievery check to undo the magic sigils allowing the font to operate; two total successes are required to disable the font.
reset: The foul font deactivates 1 minute after all creatures leave the area but resets immediately thereafter.
routine: (2 actions) The foul font uses its actions each turn to spew a single void geyser.

items.name: Void Infused
items.text: The foul font can take vitality damage, even though its an object and would normally be immune

items.name: Spew Foulness
items.text:
Trigger One or more creatures touches the water within 10 feet of the foul font

---
Effect The font fires off a Void Geyser, causing a rain of foul water. The font then rolls for initiative.

items.name: Void Geyser
items.text:
The font shoots its foul brown sludge into the air, and it rains down upon all creatures within 15 feet that aren't completely submerged. Each of those creatures takes 3d8 void damage (DC 20 basic Reflex save save). In addition, those that take damage from the font must make a DC 20 Fortitude save save.

---
Critical Success The target cannot be sickened by the font for 1 minute.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target is Sickened 1.

Critical Failure The target is Sickened 2.

items.name: Foul Waters
items.text: Any creature that is submerged downstream (east) is automatically exposed to Spew Foulness at the start of its turn or when it enters those waters, except the damage is reduced with a DC 20 basic Fortitude save save instead of Reflex.

text: The font is hidden just under the water's surface. It spews foul brown sludge into the pristine waters, leaving them reeking and polluted as they move downstream. It can be reached without swimming, but not without getting wet.
